sections.title: Letters and combinations
sections.content: Hungarian uses accented vowels such as á, é, ö and ő. sz represents the sound written as s in English, while cs represents the sound in English “church”.

Those accent marks aren't decoration — kor ("age") and kór ("illness") are different words. Hungarians hear vowel length the way English speakers hear the difference between "bit" and "beat." Treat every á/é/í/ó/ő/ú/ű as its own letter, not a typo waiting to be ignored.
